reason: As someone who has quit three of these and distrusts health promises, B wins me over: it says up front it won't promise an A1C drop, admits medication changes weren't tracked, and speaks to why I quit before (getting bored of the food, being stuck in a plan) with "nothing to cancel beyond that week." A is honest too, but it bolds the A1C result, leaves out the medication caveat and reads more like the pitches I've already fallen for.
